{{Quote|I've heard stories of ''Targonn'' that would drain your thyristors&hellip; which is probably the exact fate ''Dictator-Forever Craw'' has planned for us!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Season of Revolt 2" />}}
'''Targonn''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. This [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] planet was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Targonnian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was ruled by [[Dictator-Forever]] [[Craw]] until it was [[Targonnian Revolution|liberated]] by the [[Revoltist]]s with the help of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1999]] reference book ''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]'' states that Targonn is located in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]] region.<ref name="C-3PO">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]''</ref>
